subject: Engagement tooling: scope, SOW, and PO terms (Outreach consolidation)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@outreach.io>, Chris Yang <chris.yang@salesloft.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement tooling: implementation scope and quote request

Hi Sofia / Chris,

Quick context: we're running a review of our outbound engagement tooling to determine whether we consolidate to Outreach, move more to Salesloft, or maintain both for separate teams. Priority is reducing duplicate seat spend, simplifying sequences, and centralizing analytics in our BI stack.

Can you both send a short SOW for a conservative migration: ~300 users (rep + manager mix), sequence migration (CSV + API mapping), and 20 hours of enablement + 40 hours of data-migration engineering? Please include:
- Professional services cost (itemized)
- Timeline (calendar weeks)
- Any mandatory additional licenses for admin/analytics APIs
- Discount tiers for multi-year/seat commits and any expedited-implementation credits

We're looping legal and procurement shortly; Marissa is collecting vendor SOWs. Olga — copying you so it lands in procurement review. Marcus/Kim, flag anything I missed.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

[Attachment: implementation_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@outreach.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling: implementation scope and quote request

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a draft SOW and a high-level price breakdown for the conservative migration you described. High-level notes:
- Estimated timeline: 6 weeks (discovery + migration + enablement)
- Data migration: 40 engineering hours (mapping export/import and sequence logic)
- Enablement: 20 hours split between admin training and manager workshops
- Professional services total (pre-discount): $78,500
- Standard enterprise discount (10% on services + 5% on seats) for 12-month commit; additional 5% for multi-year.

We can flex on the migration approach if you want a phased roll-out by team. See attached Outreach_SOW_v3.pdf and price_breakdown.xlsx.

If you want, I can block time next week for a 30-minute walk-through with your engineering lead.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Strategic Accounts Lead | Outreach
sofia@outreach.io

[Attachment: Outreach_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 58KB)]
[Attachment: price_breakdown.xlsx (XLSX, 9KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 08:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling: implementation scope and quote request

Thanks, Sofia. A couple quick tech questions before we deep-dive:
1) Does the migration support delta syncs if we want to run a pilot for 50 users and keep existing activity flowing into our Snowflake warehouse?
2) Any limitations on custom object exports (we use a custom "opportunity_reason" field that we rely on for rep scoring)?

Also, are the API calls used during migration counted against a paid API quota or are they part of the services scope?

Marcus
Principal Data Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

On Sat, Apr 3, 2027 at 11:02 AM Sofia Ramos <sofia@outreach.io> wrote:
> Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear ask...

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@outreach.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling: implementation scope and quote request

Hi Marcus — quick answers below and I can get our engineering PM to confirm in the call:
1) Delta syncs are supported; for a pilot we recommend running exports daily during the pilot window and then switching to near-real-time sync with our Events API after validation. No extra charge for the migration window; the work hours are in the SOW.
2) Custom object exports are supported via our export tool and API. We typically include field mapping for up to 30 custom fields in the SOW; anything beyond we quote separately.
3) API calls used for migration during the billed professional services engagement are included in the services line item. Post-cutover production API usage is billed against standard API tiers.

We can set up a 30-minute call Thursday to run through the SOW and the data questions.

Sofia
Strategic Accounts Lead | Outreach
sofia@outreach.io

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@outreach.io>, Chris Yang <chris.yang@salesloft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling: implementation scope and quote request

Thanks Sofia — this is helpful. A few procurement items for clarity so we can move to PO issuance:
- Final line-item pricing (services + seats) and any one-time fees separated clearly in the final quote
- Acceptable billing terms: Net 30 is standard for us; we may be able to agree to Net 45 with approval but need that flagged up-front
- Cancellation/termination terms for services and refund handling if migration scope changes
- Evidence of SOC 2 Type II and a current ATO/pen-test summary (we'll need to attach to our vendor intake)

Marissa — please confirm whether we want the 12-month commit outlined by Outreach or test for a pilot with month-to-month seats for the 50-user pilot. Marcus/Kim, please review the SOC 2 request and flag any additional compliance needs.

Sincerely,
Olga Petrov
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

From: Lina Morales <lina@consultingpartners.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia@outreach.io>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling: implementation scope and quote request

Olga — Procurement note from our side (Consulting Partners is supporting Redwood for the procurement review):
- Outreach SOW looks reasonable; recommend adding a 30-day SLA for professional services response times and a clause for scope change pricing cadence (i.e., hourly rate only after a scope change sign-off).
- Negotiate a 12-month license commit with a 60% seat ramp option for the first 90 days so you don't over-commit up front; allow the pilot 50 seats month-to-month.
- Ask Outreach for a one-time implementation credit of $10k if Redwood signs within 30 days; they often have flexibility on PS credits for three-figure seat deals.
- We can draft the vendor intake packet once Sofia confirms SOC 2 artifacts and the final line-items.

I'll follow up with an annotated SOW PDF with the clauses highlighted.

Best,
Lina Morales
Director, Delivery | Consulting Partners
lina@consultingpartners.io
